sources.shortCitation: Marc Lavry Heritage Society, biography of Marc Lavry (1903–1967)
sources.fullCitation: The Marc Lavry Heritage Society. “Biography: European Period — Germany.” marclavry.org. Records that Lavry moved to Berlin in 1927, was music director and conductor for Rudolf von Laban’s dance theatre, wrote music for Max Reinhardt’s productions and for films, conducted the Berliner Sinfonie Orchester from 1928 until the orchestra was dismantled under the National Socialist regime, and left for Riga in 1933.
sources.title: Marc Lavry — biography, European period
sources.creator: The Marc Lavry Heritage Society

contributions.scopeNote: filmportal.de records this credit as “Musikalische Leitung”, spelling the name Mark Lavry. The Marc Lavry Heritage Society places him in Berlin from 1927 to 1933, conducting the Berliner Sinfonie Orchester and writing film music, which fits this 1931 production. It documents musical direction, not authorship of Kaper’s songs.
